decisions: An update readback confirms the command only when its revision is greater than the submitted revision and its values match.
Matching values at the same or an older revision cause the original update command to be retried.
Update and upload success receipts must advance beyond the submitted revision before the client adopts them.
Still-later readbacks and same-key upload replay receipts remain accepted.
Create replay and the public response schema are unchanged.
